claim_to_evidence.domain: All finite nonempty structures with exactly two strict total orders; rank-one unary point types and rank-two sentence equivalence.
claim_to_evidence.finite_check: verify_profiles.cpp, census_output.txt; 4,037,913 permutations of lengths 1 through 10; exactly 3,628,800 at length 10.
proof_steps: Rank-one types equal quadrant masks and rank-two sentence theories equal sets of realized masks.
Nine interior masks, with masks 6 and 9 mutually exclusive; endpoint ceiling gives 10.
Witnesses for n≤10 and inflation at an all-quadrants point for n>10.
Both maximal spectra forced by extreme-value interior masks.
C++ exhaustive length-ten census with two independent mask routines and dihedral canonicalization.
claim_to_evidence.unproved_limits: Not a census of every rank-two permutation theory or all extremizers at n>10; no external independent audit or proof of global novelty.

correctness.rationale: Rank-one unary types correspond exactly to four quadrant-existence masks; rank-two sentence equivalence corresponds to equality of realized masks. Interior masks 6 and 9 are incompatible, yielding the sharp all-length ten bound. Explicit witnesses prove every n≤10, inflation proves all n≥10. Two direct implementations agree on all 4,037,913 permutations of lengths 1–10. Complete length-ten enumeration gives 328, two 164-member spectra and 10 size-four plus 36 size-eight diagram-symmetry orbits.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The general EF theorem is used to identify rank-two equivalence, but does not give the combinatorial maximum ten or the two universal maximal spectra; the probabilistic theorem is incomparable.

originality.rationale: The 2018 TOTO paper establishes the language and EF methodology but no sharp bound or extremal spectrum, and the 2022 logical-limit-law paper concerns 231-avoiding asymptotics rather than all permutations. Actual published-result search returned related but logically inapplicable orbit/type profiles; no stronger theorem implying the all-size 10 ceiling plus exact first-extremizer census was found. Remaining record-profile terminology risk is explicitly recorded.
residual_risks: Potential older permutation-pattern/record-profile work under alternative terminology may already imply or tabulate the ten-type ceiling or exact length-ten extremizers.
The 328/46 census is checked during self-review with replayable code, not an independent external scientific audit.
